title: Four-term DNF for three-bit sorting
statement: Take the three-term DNF on three sign-valued coordinates whose terms require, respectively, signs $(-1,-1)$ on coordinates $(0,1)$, signs $(1,1)$ on $(1,2)$, and signs $(1,-1)$ on $(0,2)$. Append the term requiring sign $-1$ at coordinate $0$ and sign $1$ at coordinate $2$; the resulting four-term formula is the defined DNF.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the helper constructor DNFTerm.pair; the stated literal interpretation follows from the Literal and DNFTerm field descriptions.
